{{Top}}
[[File:The_Recovery_EtU.png|thumb|right|250px|An archaeologist recovers a holocron]]
{{Quote|Detective work such as this isn't much different from archaeology, after all. It's all about observation and deduction, and Auselio Gann taught me well.|Talos Drellik|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Archaeology''' was the study of ancient cultures through the analysis of old cultures and their artifacts. It was a broad science that drew upon anthropology and geology, and included [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeology]] and bioarchaeology.

[[Jedi archaeologist]]s were a type of [[Jedi historian]] that worked in the field. [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] was a xenoarchaeologist before being employed as a librarian in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. Other Jedi [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]] include [[Corask Slen'da]], [[Tyneir Renz]], and Nu's apprentice, [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]. Some [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] similarly specialized in archaeology, like [[Veren Gal]]. Amateur archaeologists [[Treasure hunting/Legends|operating for personal gain]] were typically called '''treasure hunters'''. [[Suz Tanwa]]<ref name="Yavin: The Big Red One">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040722yavin|text=Yavin: The Big Red One|int=Yavin: The Big Red One}}</ref> and [[Aach Een]]<ref name="ua">''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''</ref> were notable treasure hunters. Also, both the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]] and the [[University of Agamar]] had archaeology programs.

The [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was involved in archaeology, as was the [[Imperial Archaeological Division/Legends|Imperial Archaeological Division]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Bioarchaeology==
'''Bioarchaeology''' was a less prominent branch of archaeology than xenoarchaeology, and dealt with the specific study of excavated bone remains.

[[Josala Krenn]] was one notable bioarchaeologist.<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Archaeology is also one of the gathering skills a player can have in the [[Star Wars video games#Massively_multiplayer_online_role-playing_game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
